hero.heading: Site Preparation and Land Grading

intro.heading: Site prep that matches how the property will actually be used
intro.content: Bellhouse handles site preparation when the job needs more than a quick rough pass. That can mean stripping topsoil, shaping access, building pads for homes, barns, shops, or contractor-led projects, correcting drainage, and coordinating trucks and imported material so the next trade steps into workable ground.
keypoints: Residential, rural, and contractor-led site prep
Building pads, access routes, and working grades
Truck support, spoil movement, and imported aggregate

includes.heading: What Bellhouse site prep covers
includes.subheading: Groundwork built around the next phase of the property or project, not just a generic grading pass.

items.title: Topsoil Stripping and Ground Opening
items.description: Bellhouse removes organics and topsoil so the build area, lane, or working surface starts from a more stable base.

items.title: Rough Grading and Site Shaping
items.description: We shape the land to match drainage needs, access flow, building layout, and how the property needs to function during the work.

items.title: Building Pads and Access Routes
items.description: Bellhouse prepares pads for homes, shops, barns, and contractor-led work while also shaping lanes and access the site can actually use.

items.title: Drainage, Ditching, and Material Movement
items.description: Drainage shaping, ditching, spoil handling, and imported aggregate can stay tied together instead of being split across multiple crews.

equipment.heading: Equipment Used for Site Preparation
equipment.subheading: Heavy equipment and transport resources for efficient site clearing, grading, and earthmoving.

items.title: Dozer
items.description: Used for bulk earthmoving, stripping topsoil, rough grading, and shaping building pads.

items.title: Excavator
items.description: Handles excavation, trenching, material placement, and detailed site shaping.

items.title: Skid Steer
items.description: Used for fine grading, cleanup, material handling, and preparing surfaces for construction.

items.title: Off-Road Dump Truck
items.description: Moves material efficiently around the site without relying on public road access.

items.title: Tri-Axle Dump Truck
items.description: Hauls excavated material off-site and delivers fill, granular base, and aggregates as needed.

items.title: Laser & GPS Grade Control
items.description: Ensures accurate elevations, slopes, and consistent grading across the site.

process.heading: How Bellhouse site prep is handled
process.subheading: The useful sequence starts with access, grade, drainage, and what the next crew needs from the site.

steps.title: Review the site, plans, and access
steps.description: Bellhouse starts with the drawings, grade targets, drainage realities, and what part of the property needs to be usable first.

steps.title: Strip topsoil and open the work area
steps.description: Topsoil is stripped, stockpiled, or hauled as needed so the underlying work area can be shaped properly.

steps.title: Shape grades, pads, and access
steps.description: Bellhouse builds the rough grade, working pads, access lanes, and drainage patterns the site needs for the next phase.

steps.title: Leave the site ready for the next crew
steps.description: The finished prep work leaves the site more usable for excavation, concrete, utilities, framing, or the next material delivery.

serviceArea.heading: Service Area
serviceArea.content: Bellhouse site prep and grading work is available across linked service areas where homes, rural properties, and contractor-led jobs need the ground prepared properly before the next phase starts.

items.question: Is this page only for new residential builds?
items.answer: No. Bellhouse handles residential lot prep, rural site work, agricultural buildings, contractor-led pads, access routes, and other jobs where the site has to be made workable before the next phase.

items.question: Do you handle drainage and access problems as part of site prep?
items.answer: Yes. Bellhouse regularly handles grading, ditching, water management, and access shaping because those issues are often part of what makes a site usable or unusable.

items.question: Can Bellhouse work from engineered plans and coordinate trucks too?
items.answer: Yes. Bellhouse can work from survey or engineering drawings and can also coordinate spoil haul-out, imported aggregate, and other truck-supported material movement when the site prep needs it.

cta.heading: Need the site ready for the next crew?
cta.subheading: Send Bellhouse the location, scope, and what the property needs to be ready for if you want a direct read on site prep, grading, and next steps.
